_doc: Boss batch B1 (Sonnet generic pass): coconut-crab-titan, robber-crab-baron, reef-leviathan, ancient-snapper. Family/snd corrections only; colour left to builder defaults.

coconut-crab-titan/f:b0.note: cracking a coconut = hard bash with crack lines; frees slash for Coconut Drop

coconut-crab-titan/f:b1.note: water spout = rings of spray, not a third slash

coconut-crab-titan/f:x0.note: bait = a lure glint; builder default ripple was a no-signal guess

coconut-crab-titan/f:u3.note: husk fibres raining down; shock (electric) does not fit a crab

robber-crab-baron/f:b0.note: claw snatch = point-first grab; separates it from Sash Spatter slash

robber-crab-baron/f:x0.note: royal ring and sash glint on the decree; no tag and no keyword

robber-crab-baron/f:u1.note: quick grab-and-dash kicks up dust; shock (electric) does not fit

ancient-snapper/f:x1.note: grinding shell = heavy crushing bash, differs from the two jaw pieces

reef-leviathan/f:b1.note: breaking wave = spray puffs; frees slash from three repeats

reef-leviathan/f:x1.note: coiling crush = squeeze/bash, not a plain slash

reef-leviathan/f:x0.note: coral lurk = spiky coral ambush; no tag and no keyword

reef-leviathan/f:u2.note: whirlpool = swirling water rings; croak arcs set it apart from Deep Dive

reef-leviathan/f:u1.note: dive rings (unchanged family), pop vs Whirlpool's croak arcs
